Asset type: a single production background ornament for a Chinese Lolita wardrobe Android app, SWEET skin. This is ONE asset, not a contact sheet or a phone mockup.
Create a tall portrait 9:19 canvas on a genuinely transparent background. ONLY paint refined decorative artwork near the outer margins and two opposite corners. The entire central 65% must be totally transparent, with no fill or paper rectangle. The artwork will be layered over an existing pastel pink app background and pale content cards.
Style reference is the LEFTMOST sweet panel of the attached seven-skin art board: retain its graceful satin ribbon, airy lily-of-the-valley and scalloped lace, but REMOVE ALL opaque background and paper texture.
Composition: one substantial, graceful satin ribbon loop and bow near the upper LEFT outer corner, a slim ribbon tail tracing the far LEFT edge without entering the central content area; a few soft lily-of-the-valley stems and very sparse hand-drawn lace scallops at the lower RIGHT outer corner. Keep each motif broad enough to read at phone size and leave breathing room between shapes. The ornament does not create a closed frame. All artwork stays within the canvas, not cut off at the edges.
Medium: exquisite lightly coloured fashion engraving with soft watercolour and satin folds. Dusty petal pink, lilac-grey and warm pearl highlights; light muted contrast. Transparent gaps through the lace and between stems. Few confident shapes, avoid dense filigree or every-edge decoration. No people, clothes, hearts, stars, writing, buttons, brand marks or watermarks. No opaque base colour, no background gradient, no off-white rectangle, no drop shadow around the whole asset. True RGBA transparency around every motif and throughout the centre. Render a polished final resource, not a concept sheet.
